Context: Cenditions applicable for ad hoc Bonus :

2. Eligibility.Employee should have been in service on the last day of the relevant financial year, i.e., 31st March and should have rendered at least six months of continuous service during the relevant financial year. In the case of retirement/death during the year, pro rata ad hoc Bonus admissible, if a minimum service of six months is put in during the year. Fraction of a month after minimum six months to be rounded to the nearest month. (There is no provision for ad hoc Bonus in cases of resignation.)
